verdict_reason: The arrow-to-search-icon reskin meets AC15, keeps the upstream stacking contract, is allowed by the CSP and is covered by origin.fit.spec.js; only two Minor findings.

todos.issue: Search icon ::after is painted on every .autocomplete__wrapper, but the 35px right padding that keeps text clear of it comes only from upstream .autocomplete__input--show-all-values; the macro still supports showAllValues false, where the input has 5px padding and typed text runs underneath the icon (the upstream arrow was only rendered when showAllValues was on).
todos.fix: Set padding-right: 35px on .autocomplete__input in this file so the clearance travels with the icon, or scope the ::after to wrappers containing .autocomplete__input--show-all-values via :has().

todos.issue: Icon stroke colour is hard-coded twice as the hex %230b0c0c inside the data URI rather than derived from the GOV.UK Sass palette, so it will not follow a govuk-frontend palette change.
todos.fix: Build the data URI from the palette, e.g. interpolate the text colour (string.slice of the govuk text colour value, prefixed with %23) into the stroke attributes instead of the literal hex.
